headline: Egypt complains officials were biased in World Cup loss to Argentina
context: The Egyptian Football Association (EFA) said Wednesday it "cannot remain silent" after what it believes was unfair and biased officiating in Egypt's 3-2 round of 16 loss against Argentina on Tuesday.

sources.name: NPR
